plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Seven chained skills for everyday development with Claude Code: /init (write this repo's CLAUDE.md), /plan (turn a request or brief into a grounded plan), /implement (build it, checkpointed and resumable), /review (check your own diff before pushing), /pr-review (deep review of someone else's pull request), /pr-resolve (act on review comments), /verify (run the tests and drive the real thing). Repository-agnostic — a cached profile detects the stack, test command and runtime surface. Designed to be economical: no background agent swarms, no sub-agents by default, chat-first output.
